explanation: One of Jacob's twelve sons and the ancestor of the tribe of Judah, which later became part of the kingdom of Israel.
Son of Judah and Tamar, and one of the ancestors of King David and Jesus Christ.
The third son of Judah and his wife Bathshua. He was a brother to Perez and Serah.
A group of men known for their speed and skill in warfare, mentioned in connection with the descendants of the Kenites.
A people who lived in Canaan before the Israelites entered the land. They were descendants of Cain, and some of them became allies with the Israelites.
A leader from the tribe of Judah mentioned in 1 Chronicles 4 as one of the ancestors of several prominent families in Israel.
Another leader from the tribe of Judah mentioned in 1 Chronicles 4 as one of the ancestors of several prominent families in Israel.
A highly respected man from the tribe of Judah who asked God for blessing and protection, and God answered his prayer.
